title: Row majority cleanup
written_solution: In each row that contains exactly two nonzero colors, if one color appears once and the other appears multiple times, recolor the lone odd cell to the majority color.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (for/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range (rows g)))) (let* ((colors (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row g r)))) (counts (map (lambda (color) (count-where (lambda (v) (= v color)) (row g r))) colors))) (if (and (= (length colors) 2) (= (apply min counts) 1) (> (apply max counts) 1)) (let* ((major (first (filter (lambda (color) (= (count-where (lambda (v) (= v color)) (row g r)) (apply max counts))) colors))) (odd (first (filter (lambda (color) (= (count-where (lambda (v) (= v color)) (row g r)) 1)) colors)))) (for/fold ((acc out)) ((c (in-range (cols g)))) (if (= (at g r c) odd) (set-cell acc r c major) acc))) out)))))
